```{r setup}
#| include: false
source(here::here("R", "setup.R"))
source(path_R("spict_functions.R"))
knitr::opts_chunk$set(dpi = 110, dev = "png")

stocks <- read_stock_table()
files  <- path_data("summary", paste0(stocks$stock, "_summary.rds"))
avail  <- file.exists(files)
S      <- lapply(files[avail], readRDS)
names(S) <- stocks$stock[avail]
failed <- names(S)[vapply(S, function(x) isTRUE(x$failed), logical(1))]
ok     <- setdiff(names(S), failed)
missing_stocks <- stocks$stock[!avail]

lab <- function(stock) paste0("FU ", stocks$fu[match(stock, stocks$stock)])
fu_levels <- lab(stocks$stock)
```

::: {.callout-important}
This is an exploratory comparison. SPiCT was applied with one generic configuration to stocks that
ICES assesses with the UWTV-based Category 1 method. The results are **not** an alternative basis
for advice. Each stock would need a benchmark (stock-specific priors, index treatment, catch
history) before a SPiCT assessment could be considered.
:::

# Scope

The stocks are the `r nrow(stocks)` ICES Category 1 *Nephrops* stocks with a UWTV survey and a
UWTV-based assessment, as listed in WGNEPH 2025 [@ices2026wgneph]. Inputs are the
`r settings$sag_year` SAG records, so the last data point is the `r settings$sag_year` UWTV
survey. The model configuration follows the accepted FU32 SPiCT assessment
(`knowledge/spict_conventions.md`). Summaries are available for `r length(S)` stocks.
`r if (length(failed)) paste0("The base model failed for: ", paste(failed, collapse = ", "), ". ") else ""``r if (length(missing_stocks)) paste0("Not yet run: ", paste(missing_stocks, collapse = ", "), ".") else ""`

```{r tab-scope}
bind_rows(lapply(S, \(x) x$meta)) |>
  transmute(FU = fu, Area = area, Ecoregion = ecoregion,
            Catch = paste0(catch_start, "–", catch_end),
            UWTV = paste0(index_start, "–", index_end), `N surveys` = n_index,
            `Mean CV (%)` = round(100 * mean_index_cv, 1),
            `Discard survival (%)` = 100 * discard_survival,
            `Imputed discard years` = n_imputed_discards,
            `MSY Btrigger` = ifelse(is.na(MSYBtrigger), "none", "yes"),
            `FMSY proxy HR (%)` = FMSY_HR) |>
  kbl(caption = "Stocks, data coverage, and Category 1 reference points (SAG).") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"), font_size = 11)
```

# Acceptance of the SPiCT assessments

The checklist follows the SPiCT guidelines (`knowledge/acceptance_criteria.md`). The Mohn's rho
verdict uses the shorter-lived bar [−0.22, 0.30] of Hurtado-Ferro et al. [-@hurtadoferro2015]. The
longer-lived bar [−0.15, 0.20] is shown separately.

```{r acc}
acc <- bind_rows(lapply(ok, function(s) S[[s]]$checks |> mutate(stock = s))) |>
  mutate(FU = factor(lab(stock), fu_levels))
acc_wide <- acc |>
  filter(id <= 8) |>
  mutate(v = case_when(is.na(pass) ~ "–", pass ~ "✓", TRUE ~ "✗")) |>
  select(FU, check, v) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = check, values_from = v)
acc_n <- acc |> filter(id <= 7) |> group_by(FU) |>
  summarise(passed = sum(pass, na.rm = TRUE), evaluated = sum(!is.na(pass)),
            rho_long = any(id == 4 & pass_long %in% TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(accepted = passed == 7 & evaluated == 7)
n_acc <- sum(acc_n$accepted)
```

`r n_acc` of `r length(ok)` stocks pass all seven acceptance criteria.

```{r tab-acc}
acc_wide |>
  left_join(acc_n |> transmute(FU, `Passed (of 7)` = passed,
                                Accepted = ifelse(accepted, "yes", "no")), by = "FU") |>
  arrange(FU) |>
  kbl(caption = "Acceptance checklist by stock (✓ pass, ✗ fail, – not evaluated). Hindcast MASE is supplementary.") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"), font_size = 11)
```

```{r fig-acc}
#| fig-cap: "Which criteria fail, by stock."
#| fig-height: 5
acc |> filter(id <= 8) |>
  mutate(check = factor(check, unique(acc$check[order(acc$id)])),
         verdict = case_when(is.na(pass) ~ "not evaluated", pass ~ "pass", TRUE ~ "fail")) |>
  ggplot(aes(check, FU, fill = verdict)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(pass = "#7FB77E", fail = "#C0504D", `not evaluated` = "grey80"), name = NULL) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) + report_theme +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))
```

```{r tab-acc-values}
acc |> filter(id %in% c(3, 4, 5, 6, 8)) |>
  select(FU, check, value) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = check, values_from = value) |>
  arrange(FU) |>
  kbl(caption = "Values behind the main diagnostic criteria.") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"), font_size = 10)
```

```{r tab-osa}
bind_rows(lapply(ok, function(s) S[[s]]$residuals |> mutate(FU = lab(s)))) |>
  filter(p <= 0.05) |>
  mutate(series = recode(series, C = "catch", I1 = "index", B = "biomass", F = "fishing mortality"),
         p = signif(p, 2)) |>
  arrange(factor(FU, fu_levels)) |>
  kbl(caption = "Residual tests with p <= 0.05. Observation (catch, index) residuals enter acceptance criterion 3; process residuals are reported for information.") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE, font_size = 11)
```

```{r pars}
pars <- bind_rows(lapply(ok, function(s) S[[s]]$params |> mutate(stock = s))) |>
  mutate(FU = factor(lab(stock), fu_levels))
pp <- bind_rows(lapply(ok, function(s) S[[s]]$priors |> mutate(stock = s))) |>
  mutate(FU = factor(lab(stock), fu_levels))
```

```{r tab-pars}
pars |>
  filter(parameter %in% c("r", "K", "MSY", "Fmsy", "sdb", "sdi", "sdc")) |>
  mutate(txt = ifelse(parameter %in% c("K", "MSY"),
                      sprintf("%s (%s–%s)", signif(est, 3), signif(lo, 2), signif(hi, 2)),
                      sprintf("%.2f (%.2f–%.2f)", est, lo, hi))) |>
  select(FU, parameter, txt) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = parameter, values_from = txt) |>
  left_join(pars |> distinct(FU, bmsyk), by = "FU") |>
  arrange(FU) |>
  rename(`K (t)` = K, `MSY (t)` = MSY, `BMSY/K` = bmsyk) |>
  mutate(`BMSY/K` = round(`BMSY/K`, 2)) |>
  kbl(caption = "Parameter estimates with 95 % CI. Schaefer shape fixed (BMSY/K = 0.5).") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"), font_size = 10)
```

```{r fig-r}

```

# Comparison with the ICES Category 1 assessments

The two assessments use different kinds of reference point. MSY Btrigger in Category 1 is mostly
the lowest observed abundance (Bloss), and the FMSY proxy is a per-recruit harvest rate. SPiCT
estimates production-model BMSY and FMSY. The comparison is therefore made on **trends**
(correlations over the survey years) and on **status classifications**, not on the size of the
ratios.

```{r compare}
cmp <- bind_rows(lapply(ok, function(s) {
  x <- S[[s]]; t <- x$timeseries; st <- x$status
  last_hr <- t |> filter(!is.na(HR_FMSY_ices)) |> slice_tail(n = 1)
  last_b  <- t |> filter(!is.na(index)) |> slice_tail(n = 1)
  tibble(
    stock = s, FU = lab(s),
    cor_B = suppressWarnings(cor(log(t$BBmsy), log(t$index), use = "complete.obs")),
    cor_F = suppressWarnings(cor(log(t$FFmsy), log(t$HR_FMSY_ices), use = "complete.obs")),
    spict_BBmsy = st$BBmsy, spict_FFmsy = st$FFmsy,
    ices_B = last_b$B_Btrigger_ices, ices_F = last_hr$HR_FMSY_ices, ices_F_year = last_hr$year,
    spict_B_status = ifelse(st$BBmsy >= settings$btrigger_bmsy, "above", "below"),
    ices_B_status  = ifelse(is.na(last_b$B_Btrigger_ices), NA, ifelse(last_b$B_Btrigger_ices >= 1, "above", "below")),
    spict_F_status = ifelse(st$FFmsy <= 1, "below", "above"),
    ices_F_status  = ifelse(is.na(last_hr$HR_FMSY_ices), NA, ifelse(last_hr$HR_FMSY_ices <= 1, "below", "above"))
  )
})) |> mutate(FU = factor(FU, fu_levels))
agree_B <- with(cmp, sum(spict_B_status == ices_B_status, na.rm = TRUE)); n_B <- sum(!is.na(cmp$ices_B_status))
agree_F <- with(cmp, sum(spict_F_status == ices_F_status, na.rm = TRUE)); n_F <- sum(!is.na(cmp$ices_F_status))
```

Stock-size status (SPiCT B ≥ 0.5 BMSY vs UWTV abundance ≥ MSY Btrigger) agrees in `r agree_B` of
`r n_B` stocks with an MSY Btrigger. Fishing-pressure status (F ≤ FMSY vs HR ≤ FMSY proxy) agrees
in `r agree_F` of `r n_F` stocks. The median correlation between log B/BMSY and log UWTV abundance
is `r fmt(median(cmp$cor_B, na.rm = TRUE))`. The median correlation between log F/FMSY and log
HR/FMSY proxy is `r fmt(median(cmp$cor_F, na.rm = TRUE))`.

```{r tab-compare}
cmp |> arrange(FU) |>
  transmute(FU,
            `SPiCT B/BMSY` = round(spict_BBmsy, 2), `UWTV/MSY Btrigger` = round(ices_B, 2),
            `B status agrees` = ifelse(is.na(ices_B_status), "–", ifelse(spict_B_status == ices_B_status, "yes", "NO")),
            `SPiCT F/FMSY` = round(spict_FFmsy, 2), `HR/FMSY proxy` = round(ices_F, 2),
            `F status agrees` = ifelse(is.na(ices_F_status), "–", ifelse(spict_F_status == ices_F_status, "yes", "NO")),
            `r(B)` = round(cor_B, 2), `r(F)` = round(cor_F, 2)) |>
  kbl(caption = paste0("Terminal status. SPiCT B at the ", settings$sag_year, " survey and F in ", settings$sag_year - 1, "; Category 1 abundance from the ", settings$sag_year, " survey and HR in the last year available. r(B), r(F): correlation of log trends over survey years.")) |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"), font_size = 11)
```

```{r fig-compare}
#| fig-cap: "Terminal status from SPiCT against the Category 1 ratios. Lines: status thresholds (SPiCT 0.5 BMSY and FMSY; Category 1 MSY Btrigger and FMSY proxy). Off-diagonal quadrants are disagreements."
#| fig-height: 4.5
p1 <- cmp |> filter(!is.na(ices_B)) |>
  ggplot(aes(ices_B, spict_BBmsy, label = FU)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = 2) + geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = 2) +
  geom_point() + geom_text(size = 3, vjust = -0.7) +
  scale_x_log10() + scale_y_log10() +
  labs(x = "UWTV abundance / MSY Btrigger", y = "SPiCT B/BMSY") + report_theme
p2 <- cmp |> filter(!is.na(ices_F)) |>
  ggplot(aes(ices_F, spict_FFmsy, label = FU)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = 2) + geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = 2) +
  geom_point() + geom_text(size = 3, vjust = -0.7) +
  scale_x_log10() + scale_y_log10() +
  labs(x = "HR / FMSY proxy", y = "SPiCT F/FMSY") + report_theme
p1 + p2
```

## Catch advice

ICES Category 1 advice is total catch (landings plus all discards, including the surviving ones).
SPiCT's catch is dead removals, so the SPiCT advice (ICES MSY rule, 35th percentile) is converted
to total catch with the recent discard rate and discard survival.

```{r advice}
adv <- bind_rows(lapply(ok, function(s) S[[s]]$advice |> mutate(stock = s, FU = lab(s)))) |>
  mutate(FU = factor(FU, fu_levels))
```

```{r tab-advice}
adv |> arrange(FU) |>
  transmute(FU, `SPiCT dead removals (t)` = round(spict_catch_dead),
            `SPiCT comparable (t)` = round(spict_comparable),
            `ICES advice (t)` = round(ices_advice),
            `Advice type` = ices_advice_type,
            `SPiCT / ICES` = round(ratio_spict_ices, 2),
            `Previous ICES advice (t)` = round(ices_advice_prev),
            DOI = ices_advice_doi) |>
  kbl(caption = paste0("Catch advice for ", settings$advice_year, ": SPiCT (ICES MSY rule, 35th percentile), converted to the advice type (total catch, or landings), vs the published ICES advice. FU 13: sum of the Clyde and Jura advice.")) |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"), font_size = 10)
```

```{r fig-advice}
#| fig-cap: "Ratio of SPiCT advice (total-catch equivalent) to ICES advice. Colour: whether the SPiCT assessment passes all acceptance criteria."
#| fig-height: 4.5
adv |> left_join(acc_n |> select(FU, accepted), by = "FU") |>
  ggplot(aes(ratio_spict_ices, FU, colour = accepted)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = 2) + geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  scale_x_log10() + scale_colour_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#2C5F8A", `FALSE` = "#C0504D"),
                                        labels = c(`TRUE` = "accepted", `FALSE` = "not accepted"), name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "SPiCT / ICES advice (log scale)", y = NULL) + report_theme
```

# Robustness to configuration choices

```{r sens}
sens <- bind_rows(lapply(ok, function(s) if (!is.null(S[[s]]$sensitivity)) S[[s]]$sensitivity |> mutate(stock = s))) |>
  mutate(FU = factor(lab(stock), fu_levels))
sens_sum <- sens |> group_by(FU) |>
  summarise(runs = n(), converged = sum(converged),
            B_min = min(BBmsy, na.rm = TRUE), B_max = max(BBmsy, na.rm = TRUE),
            F_min = min(FFmsy, na.rm = TRUE), F_max = max(FFmsy, na.rm = TRUE),
            B_status_flips = n_distinct(BBmsy[converged] >= settings$btrigger_bmsy) > 1,
            F_status_flips = n_distinct(FFmsy[converged] <= 1) > 1, .groups = "drop")
```

Across the sensitivity runs, the stock-size classification (relative to 0.5 BMSY) changes in
`r sum(sens_sum$B_status_flips)` of `r nrow(sens_sum)` stocks. The fishing-pressure
classification (relative to FMSY) changes in `r sum(sens_sum$F_status_flips)`.

```{r fig-sens}
#| fig-cap: "Terminal B/BMSY and F/FMSY across sensitivity runs (points) and base run (cross)."
#| fig-height: 6
sens |> filter(converged) |>
  select(FU, label, BBmsy, FFmsy) |>
  pivot_longer(c(BBmsy, FFmsy)) |>
  mutate(name = recode(name, BBmsy = "B/BMSY", FFmsy = "F/FMSY")) |>
  ggplot(aes(value, FU)) +
  geom_vline(data = tibble(name = c("B/BMSY", "B/BMSY", "F/FMSY"), x = c(0.5, 1, 1)), aes(xintercept = x), linetype = 2) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, colour = "grey30") +
  geom_point(data = \(x) filter(x, label == "Base"), shape = 4, size = 3, colour = "#C0504D") +
  facet_wrap(~name, scales = "free_x") + scale_x_log10() +
  labs(x = "Estimate (log scale)", y = NULL) + report_theme
```

## Index observation error

UWTV confidence intervals capture sampling variance only. Bias and variance from burrow
identification, edge effects, the one-burrow-one-animal assumption and changes in survey design
are not included, so they are likely too narrow. Three runs widen the index error relative to the
base (prior median = mean UWTV CV): the prior median at 2 and 3 times the CV, and no prior.

```{r sdi}
cv_tab <- tibble(stock = ok, cv = vapply(ok, \(s) S[[s]]$meta$mean_index_cv, numeric(1))) |>
  mutate(FU = factor(lab(stock), fu_levels))
sdi_runs <- c("Base", "sdi prior x2", "sdi prior x3", "sdi prior off")
sdi_tab <- sens |> filter(label %in% sdi_runs) |>
  left_join(cv_tab |> select(stock, cv), by = "stock") |>
  group_by(FU) |>
  mutate(base_B = BBmsy[label == "Base"][1], base_F = FFmsy[label == "Base"][1]) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(sdi_cv = sdi / cv, dB = BBmsy / base_B - 1, dF = FFmsy / base_F - 1)
x3 <- sdi_tab |> filter(label == "sdi prior x3", converged)
base_sdi <- sdi_tab |> filter(label == "Base", converged)
```

In the base runs the estimated sdi is a median of `r fmt(median(base_sdi$sdi_cv), 1)` times the
UWTV CV (range `r fmt(min(base_sdi$sdi_cv), 1)`–`r fmt(max(base_sdi$sdi_cv), 1)`). With the prior
at 3 × CV, `r nrow(x3)` of `r sum(sdi_tab$label == "sdi prior x3")` runs converged. Their terminal
B/BMSY moves by a median of `r fmt(100 * median(abs(x3$dB)), 0)` % from the base run (maximum
`r fmt(100 * max(abs(x3$dB)), 0)` %), and F/FMSY by a median of `r fmt(100 * median(abs(x3$dF)), 0)` %
(maximum `r fmt(100 * max(abs(x3$dF)), 0)` %).

```{r tab-sdi}
sdi_tab |>
  transmute(FU, run = label, converged, `UWTV CV` = round(cv, 3), sdi = round(sdi, 3),
            `sdi / CV` = round(sdi_cv, 1), `B/BMSY` = round(BBmsy, 2),
            `change B` = sprintf("%+.0f %%", 100 * dB), `F/FMSY` = round(FFmsy, 2),
            `change F` = sprintf("%+.0f %%", 100 * dF), `CI B (log10)` = round(ci_B, 2),
            `OSA fails` = osa_fail) |>
  mutate(run = factor(run, sdi_runs)) |> arrange(FU, run) |>
  kbl(caption = "Base and index-error runs: estimated sdi relative to the UWTV CV and change in terminal status.") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"), font_size = 10) |>
  scroll_box(height = "450px")
```

```{r fig-sdi}
#| fig-cap: "Terminal B/BMSY (95 % CI) in the base run and with wider index observation error."
#| fig-height: 6
sdi_tab |> filter(converged) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, rev(sdi_runs))) |>
  ggplot(aes(BBmsy, FU, colour = label)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(0.5, 1), linetype = 2) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = BBmsy_lo, xmax = BBmsy_hi), position = position_dodge(width = 0.6), size = 0.2) +
  scale_x_log10() + labs(x = "B/BMSY (log scale)", y = NULL, colour = NULL) + report_theme
```

sens_sum |> arrange(FU) |>
  mutate(across(c(B_min, B_max, F_min, F_max), ~round(.x, 2)),
         across(c(B_status_flips, F_status_flips), ~ifelse(.x, "YES", "no"))) |>

# Caveats

- The UWTV index counts animals, while SPiCT models biomass. The "Biomass index" sensitivity run
  tests the effect of mean-weight changes, using the mean weight of the removals.
- Priors are generic: r is a *Nephrops* meta-analysis value from the FU32 template, and B0/K is
  weakly informative. Where the posterior/prior SD ratio is near 1, the estimate reflects the
  prior.
- UWTV CVs measure sampling precision only and are likely too narrow. `sdi` is estimated with a
  prior centred on the mean CV, with SD 0.5 (wider than in FU32), and tested with 2 × and 3 × the
  CV and with no prior (section "Index observation error").
- Discards before the first year of discard data are imputed.
- Short UWTV series (FU 3-4, 16, 20-21, 23-24) have little contrast.

# Reproducibility

Inputs: SAG `r settings$sag_year` records cached in `data/sag/`, ICES advice in `data/asd/`.
spict `r unique(vapply(S[ok], \(x) x$spict_version, ""))`. Stock documents in `stock/<stock>/`.
Rerun with `Rscript R/render_all.R`.
